definitions.gloss: turning point, transition period, change of season
definitions.explanation: The point or period at which something changes from one state to another. Commonly used for seasonal transitions, life transitions, or any boundary between two different phases.

examples.japanese: ⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{変|か}わり{目|め}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{体調|たいちょう}を{崩|くず}す→体調を崩す：16480_taichouwokuzusu⟧。
examples.english: I get sick at the change of seasons.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{変|か}わり{目|め}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{感|かん}じている→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: I feel that now is a turning point in my life.

examples.japanese: ⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{変|か}わり{目|め}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ひきやすい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{服装|ふくそう}→服装：03594_fukusou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{気|き}をつけて⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: You tend to catch colds at the change of seasons, so please be careful about what you wear.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly used in the phrase ⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{変|か}わり{目|め} (change of seasons), which is a very frequent expression in daily Japanese. The word conveys the idea of an in-between period when things are shifting. It can also apply to life stages, eras, and other transitions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{変|か}わり{目|め}: change of seasons
- ⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{変|か}わり{目|め}: turning point in life
- ⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{変|か}わり{目|め}: turning point of an era
- {変|か}わり{目|め}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{体調|たいちょう}を{崩|くず}す→体調を崩す：16480_taichouwokuzusu⟧: to fall ill at a transitional period
